title: Humanoid
tagline: An Account Abstraction wallet and DApp that aims to solve ownership problems in Latin America.
description: Humanoid is an Account Abstraction wallet and DApp that aims to solve ownership problems in Latin America. By account abstraction we refer to Vitalik's ERC 4337 which is without protocol changes. In essense we seek instead of using ECDSA and seed phrases to scale the account to the smart contract level. This would let us have different kind of signatures and methods of validation and most of all integrate proofs of Humanity into the account that would allow for recovery. This can be applied for public goods offering in order to solve one of the most strident problems in Latin America that accross history has plagued the region and is the seed for much inequality: Land ownership.
how_its_made: Keep in mind that the central part of the project is related to Account Abstraction. That is done through a main Smart Contract written in Solidity and running in the Polygon Network. The login and main wallet infrastructure is created using WalletConnect and Metamask. Notifications are handled with the Push Network and for most websockets we are employing Streamr. XMTP is used for communication with other wallets through our chat (we finally found an application for a chat that makes sense). More sponsors to be included if we have time*
